purpose: Validate a shortlist-first production funnel with twelve ultra-realistic, weaponless, unaligned 1-star identity anchors before scaling toward two 100-candidate waves.
decision: The shortlist interaction model remains useful, but the literal photographic hero rendering was rejected on 2026-09-02 and must not guide future production.

selectionFunnel.note: Seven hundred images describes the final 100 complete sets. Producing and screening 200 base candidates makes the minimum generation count 800 before retries.

proposedEvolutionGrammar.visualState: Current practical baseline; one memorable personal cue; no supernatural effects.
Equivalent to the former 3-star treatment: refined fit, clearer role and stronger construction.
Equivalent to the former 5-star costume complexity, but grounded and not floating.
Intermediate awakened construction between the grounded 3-star form and overtly supernatural 5-star form.
First unmistakably awakened form; floating may begin but is optional and identity-specific.
Rare mature resonance integrated into the hero's personal motif.
Singular culmination, decisively beyond 6-star without overwhelming the readable human identity.

evolutionInvariants: Rank never invents a smile, grin, or exaggerated facial expression; the identity's baseline affect remains stable.
Conditioning, posture, vitality, grooming, and material quality may improve with evolution.
Thinness is not a universal power signal; core body type remains recognizable and may become a healthier, stronger version of itself.
Armor improves only for identities whose role and authored progression support armor; it is not a universal rank uniform.
Only 1-star through 5-star heroes may be summoned. Six-star and seven-star forms are evolution-only.
Candidate pixels do not approve an identity or redefine its manifest.
